name: Kimi ga Nozomu Eien ~Special Fan Disc~
source:
A fan disc for Kimi ga Nozomu Eien.

Contains:
[i]Kimi ga Nozomu Dai Isshou[/i]

A retelling of the first chapter of the original game, adding in additional routes for all the heroines who appear in the first chapter.

[i]Kimi ga Nozomu Eien ~Another Episode Collection~[/i]

A collection of ten short stories from the world of "Kimi ga Nozomu Eien".

[i]KimiNozo Radio Shucchouban[/i]

KimiNozo radio specials.

[i]Marie no Okatazuke 2 AyuMayu Funtou-hen[/i]

A puzzle game starring AyuMayu.
